name: mazingira-mcp
description: MCP server for Kenya environment — NEMA permits, climate data, conservation areas, environmental rights, and climate adaptation

tools.name: nema_permit_guide
tools.description: What environmental permit or assessment an activity needs from NEMA in Kenya (EIA, audit or licence), with the threshold, process and penalty. Use when someone plans construction, farming, mining, manufacturing or similar. activity_type is matched by text; an unrecognised activity returns an error listing the valid ones instead of the construction EIA. county is only echoed back. Returns the source label, the activity, the permit type, threshold, steps, NEMA contact and a penalty note. Static summary labelled DEMO: confirm with NEMA. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: climate_data_guide
tools.description: Where to get Kenyan weather, climate, drought and related data, with the publisher, URL and what each offers. Use when someone asks where to find official climate data. data_type matches a source by text; if none match, ALL sources are returned. county is only echoed back. Returns the source label, the matching sources and a pointer to NDMA and wapimaji-mcp. Portals were current as of 2025 and are labelled DEMO: addresses can change. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: conservation_areas
tools.description: List sample protected areas in Kenya (national parks, reserves, forests) with county, type and manager. Use when someone asks what protected areas exist in a county or of a type. county and area_type filter by matching text; if nothing matches, the list is empty. Returns the source label, the filters, the matching areas and a note on buffer-zone restrictions with KWS and KFS pointers. A short sample labelled DEMO, not the full list: see kws.go.ke. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: environmental_rights_query
tools.description: Environmental rights in Kenya under Article 42 of the Constitution and the Environment and Land Management Act: a clean environment, access to information, public participation and how to enforce them. Use when someone asks what they can do about pollution or a harmful project. Keywords in topic select entries; if none match, ALL rights are returned. Returns the source label, topic, rights, NEMA and Environment and Land Court pointers and a not-legal-advice disclaimer. Static summary labelled DEMO: consult an advocate. Read-only; no side effects.

tools.name: climate_adaptation_guide
tools.description: Climate adaptation strategies by sector (such as agriculture, water or infrastructure) with pointers to KALRO, NDMA and the national climate change action plan. Use when someone asks how to adapt farming or services to climate change. region is only echoed back; an unrecognised sector returns a single general sentence, not a tailored strategy. Returns the source label, region, sector, strategies and the pointers. General guidance labelled DEMO: take local advice from KALRO or the county. Read-only; no side effects.
